This dead red '''moon''' lay in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Orbit/Legends|Orbiting]] the [[Unidentified planet (dead red moon)|third]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] terrain consisted entirely of barren red rock, without any [[Plant/Legends|flora]] or fauna to break up the terrain, although the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] could support life. By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the moon's indigenous [[Species/Legends|species]] had been extinct for millennia, although their underground tunnels remained.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the moon was taken over by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]]. Soresh was [[Battle of Belazura|fleeing]] the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and landed on the moon to [[Rezi Soresh's outpost|regain his power]]. After capturing the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] colony [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] [[Endeavor (Arkanian starship)|''Endeavor'']], Soresh contacted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] his hostages if Skywalker didn't travel to Soresh's outpost. Once Skywalker arrived with his companions, the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]], Soresh captured them and attempted to [[Project Omega|brainwash]] Skywalker.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

As part of his plan for revenge, Soresh drew both the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and the Rebel [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] to the system and planned on [[Battle of the Sixela system|destroying]] the two opposing fleets by creating a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] using [[resonance torpedo]]es. Skywalker escaped during the battle, and Soresh was killed as he attempted to board the the Rebels' starship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Soresh ultimately blew the [[Star/Legends|system's sun]], but the fleets escaped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] before the moon was vaporized.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Description==
This barren red rock [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Unidentified planet (dead red moon)|third]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its terrain consisted of craters, with a layer of thin dust. A thin [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] made the moon viable for [[Human/Legends|Human]] life, but nothing disturbed the acrid air, and there was no [[Plant/Legends|flora]] or fauna on the moon.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==History==
This moon supported a civilization, but any life was extinct for millennia before the moon was visited again in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Twenty-seven days [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] found this moon after his [[Battle of Belazura|exile]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As the atmosphere could support life, he spent [[Time/Legends|time]] converting it to his personal use to gain revenge for his exile, establishing an [[Rezi Soresh's outpost|outpost]] on the equator. He eventually captured a [[Endeavor (Arkanian starship)|colony]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] full of 100 civilians to use as hostages to draw [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to the system. After [[Mission to Nyemari|he was contacted]], Skywalker wanted to go to save the hostages, but his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|companions]] would not let him go alone.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] arrived on the moon. The Rebel operative [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] disembarked and met a [[Rezi Soresh (impostor)|hooded man]]. Two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] then strafed the compound, angering the hooded man. The impostor was subsequently [[Death/Legends|gunned down]] by Solo. Skywalker and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] disembarked from the X-wings to analyze the situation, but a series of [[Mine/Legends|mines]] started exploding amongst the hostages. They rushed to assist, and Skywalker was hit with a [[Force pike/Legends|Force pike]] by a disguised Soresh. Skywalker's companions were captured by Soresh's drugged bodyguards. Soresh began [[Project Omega|brainwashing]] Skywalker, attempting to turn him into an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

Using a brainwashed Rebel [[Scout/Legends|scout]], Soresh passed on information to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] regarding a secret meeting of the [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]]. In his control center, Soresh also contacted [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

The Rebels were imprisoned on the moon for two weeks in total. During that time, Soresh presented Skywalker to his friends and ordered him to kill them; a timely distraction by the Rebel's [[Droid/Legends|droids]], who had remained hidden, allowed them to escape. Skywalker saved Solo and revealed his ruse, but asked Solo to shoot him in the shoulder to stay with Soresh and investigate further. Soresh later found a semi-conscious Skywalker and commented on his loyalty. Back on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], the Alliance Fleet was preparing for an attack. The former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ferus Olin]] was suspicious of the intercepted information, and a visit by a [[Force ghost/Legends|spectral]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] convinced him to trust his instincts. With his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] friend [[Lune Oddo Divinian|Div]], [[Ferus Olin]] launched an unsanctioned reconnaissance mission to the moon. Picking up a distress signal on a Rebel frequency, Olin landed and met with Solo and Organa.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

When the opposing [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] arrived, Skywalker betrayed Soresh. Instead of launching the resonance torpedoes, Skywalker turned on Soresh's bodyguards. Angered, Soresh ran off and launched his [[resonance torpedo]]es to destroy everything in the system. Skywalker and Solo then joined the [[Battle of the Sixela system|battle]] [[Space warfare/Legends|waging]] in orbit between the two fleets. When the torpedoes hit the system's sun, they started a chain reaction which would force the sun to detonate in 40 [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

Both fleets withdrew, allowing Skywalker to return to the surface and rescue the remaining hostages. Darth Vader had also landed to confront Soresh, but found and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|dueled]] Olin instead. With minutes to spare, the Rebels were boarding the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] when Soresh appeared. He attempted to shoot Skywalker, but was blasted instead by Solo. After the ''Falcon'' escaped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the moon and everything else in the system were turned into [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] and dust when the sun went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. Unbeknownst to the Rebels, Vader also escaped.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Inhabitants==
The moon was inhabited once, but the civilization was long dead by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When Rezi Soresh landed here in his ancient [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]], he took over the moon for his purposes. He captured the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] vessel ''Endeavor'', and held the 100 passengers hostage on the moon. Soresh was killed and the hostages evacuated before the system exploded.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Locations==
The ancient inhabitants established an elaborate system of underground tunnels. Soresh used the tunnels under his outpost on the moon's equator. Soresh used the data he acquired in his duty as an Imperial bureaucrat to blackmail others for the resources to establish his outpost, which consisted of a cluster of small fortified buildings, electrified pens, and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
The moon's location and features were established in its sole appearance, [[Alex Wheeler]]'s ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''. Early on, the book says the moon orbits the third planet in the system, but later says it orbits the sixth planet. A number of other discrepancies exist throughout the book.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

The moon was later mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />
